priorityActions.action: Title Restructure — Lead with Size + Primary Keyword
priorityActions.description: Current title leads with 'Velvet Couch Cover' but size (71"x118") is hidden in parenthetical. Rearrange to: [Brand] + [Product] + [Size] + [Key Benefit] + [Material]. Competitors show size in title prominently.

priorityActions.action: Bullet 1 Compression — Remove 1-PCS Sales Model Confusion
priorityActions.description: Bullet 1 currently explains 'sold individually, not as a set' in the middle of a benefit paragraph. Move this to a separate sentence at the end OR remove if it creates confusion. Compress to ≤200 chars.

Competitors (RV Dinette Cushion Covers) serve the RV/camper niche with high-margin products. Target listing doesn't mention RV compatibility at all despite fitting certain RV sofa dimensions. A bullet or A+ mention could unlock this segment.
'Suitable for year-round use' has no thermal data to support. Remove or change to 'suitable for all seasons'. Low risk but removes a potential compliance flag.

priorityActions.action: Add 'Sofa Makeover' Positioning for Budget Decorators
priorityActions.description: Bullet 1 or new A+ content should explicitly frame this as a 'sofa transformation' — budget-friendly alternative to buying new furniture. Budget decorators search for 'sofa refresh', 'couch makeover' terms.
priorityActions.expectedLift: +3-5% relevance for budget decoration intent segment

summary: Top 3 actions that deliver most impact for least effort: (1) Title restructure with size prominent, (2) Bullet 1 compression, (3) RV niche mention. These three alone address the major gaps identified in Cosmo scoring and keyword audit.
